description: Fetch one repository by name (default: the flagship repo). Provider-shaped, with provider-form ids.

provider.description: The git host to read the repository from, one of the ids orient lists: 'github', 'gitlab', 'bitbucket' or 'ado', e.g. 'github'.

repo.description: The repository name without the organisation, e.g. 'parthenon', the flagship repo, which is used when omitted.

name: get_repository
title: Get a repository
